Articles

All vignettes

Agreement Tests

Legacy agreement tests in SimplyAgree (agree_test, agree_reps, agree_nest), plus concordance correlation (CCC) and non-parametric limits of agreement with agree_np.

Agreement & Tolerance Limits

Bland-Altman limits of agreement and tolerance limits in R with agreement_limit() and tolerance_limit(), for simple, replicate, and nested data.

Agreement for Categorical and Ordinal Ratings

Agreement for categorical and ordinal ratings in R: kappa, Gwet’s AC1, and Krippendorff’s alpha with cac_test(), and model-based kappa for many raters with ord_kappa_test().

Errors-in-Variables Regression

Errors-in-variables regression for method comparison in R: Deming regression with dem_reg() and Passing-Bablok regression with pb_reg().

Power Analysis and Sample Size Determination for Agreement Studies

Power analysis and sample size planning for Bland-Altman agreement studies: exact agreement tests, limits of agreement power, expected CI half-width, and assurance.

Re-analysis of an Agreement Study

Worked example re-analysing a published agreement study of rectal vs. esophageal temperature with concordance correlation, limits of agreement, and tolerance limits.

Reliability Analysis

Test-retest and inter-rater reliability in R: intraclass correlation (ICC) with icc_test(), SEM and coefficient of variation, minimal detectable change, and study planning.
